card.name: Overdosage management instructions
card.fires_on: Words that start the management advice in overdosage sections, such as 'should', 'treatment' or 'treated' right after 'In the event of overdosage' or 'The physician'. Also a few punctuation marks in similar instructions.

modes.label: Advice after overdosage
modes.description: The word 'treatment' or 'treated' that follows an overdose statement and leads into symptomatic and supportive care.
modes.example: In the event of overdosage,<< treatment>> should be symptomatic and supportive.

modes.label: Physician should
modes.description: The word 'should' after 'The physician' when advising a poison control call.
modes.example: The physician<< should>> consider contacting a poison control center on the
